title: Super projecting lights for all party uses! Amazingly good!
text: This is a super cool product. I live in a new 'cool' 55 and older community in the Daytona Beach area and we have parties at neighbor homes several times a week. When I first set these up I wasn't sure what to expect. But after seeing the  variety of lights, patterns and speeds I knew this would be a hit. We had a Motown party last weekend and this projector was the highlight of the night! Great colors, great remote control capability and even responds to voice commands. This would be a great addition to any home (young or old) for use when there is a party to be had. I definitely highly recommend this gadget for all ages and holidays!
